items.rationale: Catalog inherits one-kernel architecture and introduces no alternate production kernel.
No kernel I/O change; testbank metadata and replay remain outside the kernel.
Case metadata keeps parameters, forcing, state, numerical policy and results conceptually separate.
No persistent runtime state is added; catalog metadata is external evidence.
No solver scratch ownership changes.
No production memory layout or batching change.
No timestep implementation change; transactional requirements remain inherited.
No recomputation/warm-start semantics changed.
Static constitutive cases explicitly mark time as not applicable; no day-based kernel assumption introduced.
No coupling-window restriction introduced.
Coupling remains core architecture; F-TB02 does not replace coupling qualification.
No groundwater interface contract changes.
Pure constitutive cases are non-water-bearing; FSI24 remains hard-mass-gated and no relaxation is introduced.
No sensitivity-output contract changes; dK/dh is cataloged as constitutive evidence only.
No coupling execution-cost path changes.
No MultiSWAP runtime or per-column solver instance changes.
No MODFLOW-cell/tile composition assumptions introduced.
Deep-vadose remains external and untouched.
No component transition or stored-water transfer changes.
Catalog tests constitutive behavior independently of a single future soil-water solver implementation.
No duplicated production physics is introduced; historical evidence is indexed, not copied into kernel code.
No module is coupled to HeadCalc internals by this catalog.
Hydraulic physics evidence and solver/performance policy are kept distinct; SWAP-011 cannot be justified by speed alone.
No bounded-cost or fallback policy change; performance evidence cannot override scientific gates.
Reference/full-accuracy authority remains available; higher oracle hierarchy is preserved.
Catalog records diagnostics/evidence without creating a second runtime state authority.
No optional module memory or compute is introduced.
No runtime/coupler system-composition responsibilities are moved into SWAP.
Cases use exact source authorities and explicit static/generic-time semantics; no hidden .swp/day/MODFLOW assumption is created.
This file explicitly audits F-TB02 against all 30 architecture invariants.
